message: ビッグブリッジな死闘

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my... I wonder what's going on.」
A familiar light-a warm, gentle light-flickered in the distance.

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyufufu. If you think you can escape, you're dead wrong, nya♪」

name: Pasta
message: 「Pasta will finish you off at the end, nya!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haa, haa... Sorry to keep you waiting~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「Just when I thought you'd been quiet for a while... What are you planning to do this time!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I didn't have time to play around with you guys, nya. Thanks to that, the mission is smooth sailing, nya.」

name: Pasta
message: 「However, Pasta's anger knows no bounds, nya!! Not until I've struck down you detestable brats!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think you can still keep going?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, I'm fine. Because you came for me, Synn-kun」

name: Pasta
message: 「Now, the road race from hell begins, nyaaan!!」
